So I definitely heard part of Blue/Green’s champion theme, and part of Geeta’s champion theme. 
I saw someone say the synth is reminiscent of N’s battle theme, and N was the Champion when you faced him in his final battle. 
I also heard the drums they love to use Alola, mostly with the Recon Squad and Hau, so they’re probably referencing Hau’s battle theme. 
So this seems to be taking bits and pieces of every champion theme. Or at least notable ones. 
RB/FRLG - First Champion 
BW N - First Villainous Champion? Not sure on this one tbh. 
SM Hau - First challenger to You being champion 
Geeta - most recent/current champion
For Blue's theme I believe they are specifically referencing the remix that was used for VGC Worlds in BW and XY.

The intro fanfare (not heard in this rip but in the other versions from the live stream) is straight from the previous WCS vs Blue remixes

The intro (and other parts of the song that use the same instruments) is very obviously vs N (final) in the synth and baseline

The main melody that kicks in around 0:24 is a modified version of the intro to vs Steven (there's a few extra notes interspersed because I think the intent is to make it also reminiscent of the Z-A mega themes since we're in a mega evolution format, but the chords/progression are the same)

There's a little bit at the end of the first guitar solo before it loops back to the modified vs Steven melody around 0:45-0:48 that's from vs Alder/Subway Bosses

the little transition part with the horns right before it goes into the big vs Blue remix at 1:03-1:04 or so is vs Geeta

1:04-1:41 or so is the obvious vs Blue remix

the section right after with the very drum forward bit and a lot of the other instruments dropping out (1:42-1:53ish) is very reminiscent of Alola title defense (and other alola tracks), you're right (I think I also hear Hau's drums at the beginning of the song too?)

I want to say that the guitar riff at around 2:01 right before loop is maybe from vs Nemona final? but I could be wrong on that part

notably all the tracks sampled are from champion themes of some sort, it's really neat!
@AbsqueNomen Vs Kieran 2 is in there too! At that end point before the loop! We literally have… ALL the Champions! Only one we’re missing is Lance and Red’s theme (ironically!)
